* [[Cricket]]: [[New Zealand]] prevents India from snatching victory in the first [[Test cricket]] at [[Ahmedabad]].<ref>{{cite news|url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/cricket/3183880.stm|title=BBC SPORT - Cricket - McMillan defies India|date=12 October 2003|publisher=|accessdate=22 December 2015}}</ref>
* Relations between Syria and the United States fall to a low point as Syria criticizes the US for its failure to censure Israel.<ref>[https://www.nytimes.com/2003/10/12/international/middleeast/12SYRI.html?th Syrian Official Says Relations With U.S. Plunge to New Low - NYTimes.com<!-- Bot generated title -->]</ref>
* China confirms that it will launch its first [[manned space mission]] between October 15 and 17.  The [[spacecraft]] plans to [[orbit]] Earth 14 times before landing in an undisclosed location. (See [[Shenzhou 5]])<ref>{{cite news|url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/asia-pacific/3180618.stm|title=BBC NEWS - Asia-Pacific - China space launch confirmed|date=10 October 2003|publisher=|accessdate=22 December 2015}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://english.peopledaily.com.cn/200310/10/eng20031010_125762.shtml|title=China's first manned spacecraft to blast off next week|publisher=|accessdate=22 December 2015}}</ref>
* The operation to separate two-year-old [[Egypt]]ian twins joined at the head is going well in [[Dallas, Texas|Dallas]]; the two boys have been separated and no troublesome complications have arisen. The next steps are to reconstruct the boys' skulls including the skin.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://story.news.yahoo.com/news?tmpl=story&cid=514&e=3&u=%2Fap%2F20031012%2Fap_on_he_me%2Fegyptian_twins |title=Yahoo News - Latest News & Headlines |access-date=July 29, 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050130012141/http://story.news.yahoo.com/news?tmpl=story&cid=514&e=3&u=%2Fap%2F20031012%2Fap_on_he_me%2Fegyptian_twins |archive-date=January 30, 2005 |url-status=live }}</ref>
* India, Thailand, and China press ahead with efforts and a study group aimed at creating a [[Free Trade Area]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://articles.timesofindia.indiatimes.com/2003-10-13/india/27216297_1_asean-summit-joint-study-group-india-and-china|title=India, China to move fast on free trade|work=The Times of India|accessdate=22 December 2015}}{{Dead link|date=August 2021 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>
* [[Post-invasion Iraq, 2003–present|2003 occupation of Iraq]]: A huge explosion occurs in the center of [[Baghdad]], possibly caused by car bomb. A number of fatalities are reported. The blast takes place in [[Baghdad Hotel]].<ref>{{cite news|url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/middle_east/3185014.stm|title=BBC NEWS - Middle East - Baghdad coalition hotel base bombed|date=12 October 2003|publisher=|accessdate=22 December 2015}}</ref>
* Researchers announced that they have discovered the detailed relationship between the [[Ras v12]] gene, [[polarity gene]]s, and [[metastasis]] of [[cancer]] in [[Drosophila melanogaster|fruit flies]].<ref>[http://www.newhavenregister.com/site/news.cfm?newsid=10297208&BRD=1281&PAG=461&dept_id=517515&rfi=6] {{dead link|date=August 2016|bot=medic}}{{cbignore|bot=medic}}</ref>
* Liberia drops diplomatic relations with the [[Taiwan]] and re-establishes ties with [[China]]. This move was seen largely as a result of China's lobbying in the [[United Nations]], which is planning to deploy a peacekeeping force to Liberia. Taiwanese Foreign Minister Eugene Chien offers to resign as a result.<ref>http://famulus.msnbc.com/FamulusIntl/reuters10-12-054050.asp?reg=PACRIM{{Dead link|date=July 2019 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>
